description: SuperDove (PSB.SD) imager on Planet's Flock CubeSats: 8-band instrument; NJM holds the Blue, Green, Red, NIR and Red Edge relative spectral responses.
facility_description: Flock is Planet Labs' constellation of 3U Dove CubeSats imaging the Earth's land surface near-daily (PlanetScope).
notes: Planet docs: SuperDove PSB.SD is built "with a telescope we call "PSB" and the same filter response as PS2.SD instrument", adding red edge, green I, coastal blue and yellow channels. NJM has only 5 of the 8 bands. Planet's RSR support article returned 403. Commercial satellite: redistribution not clearly allowed.
